# Purchase source workflows

In-module source correction, due payment and returns reuse the actual PurchaseEditor, PurchaseCart, CompoundQuantityInput, PurchasePaymentPanel and existing dialog/select/input/report primitives. Purchase cart phone/tablet styling is reused unchanged from #72; return mode hides product addition and locks original costs, while preserving the shared quantity/unit controls.

Newly created bills retain entered cart/product/unit/cost/rounding snapshots and a source revision. Corrections preserve identity/supplier and show reason, before/after totals and stock quantities. Later payments or returns block source rewriting pending a verified allocation review. Payments cannot exceed the remaining bill due. Returns cannot exceed the remaining original quantity; exact paisa allocation retains discounts and rounding, including repeated partial and zero-value item returns. Unpaid due decreases first; the remainder becomes supplier credit or a matching cash/bank/MFS refund. Preview history, stock quantities/lots and source-helper balances follow the saved source. Repeated stale commands fail rather than post twice.

Summary-only old fixtures and serial/batch/expiry-tracked returns remain explicitly unavailable until complete source/allocation data is supplied. Original stock and financial posting remain backend integration boundaries. In particular, the independent Party/Finance/Audit preview fixtures must be replaced with projections of the same backend command result; this slice does not claim backend posting or cross-store persistence. Source helpers are tested; existing seeded Party records remain independent.

Validation: strict TypeScript, zero lint errors (existing warnings retained), build, UI design contract, 341 helper tests; ten full correction/payment/partial-return/refund/history journeys across 320/390/768/1024/1440px and light/dark. Original purchase create/quick-add and Expense regressions must also pass. No new cart/picker/payment lookalikes. Stack after #80; no merge without approval.
